news.headline: India pursues Xinjiang air route with China to mitigate Pakistan airspace ban: Aviation minister Ram Mohan Naidu
news.story_lead: India is actively exploring an alternative air corridor over China’s Xinjiang region to mitigate the operational and financial impacts of the continued closure of Pakistani airspace. Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu stated that discussions are ongoing between India and China regarding the proposed route over Hotan. If finalized, the route could significantly reduce flight times and fuel burn for flights heading to Europe, the UK, and North America.
news.full_article_text: India is currently exploring an alternative air route over China’s Xinjiang to reduce the impact of the continued closure of Pakistani airspace. Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu announced that discussions are underway between the two countries for a proposed corridor over Hotan in southwestern Xinjiang, which would offer a significantly shorter route for international flights. Pakistani airspace was closed following the Pahalgam terror attack in April 2025, forcing Indian airlines operating flights to Europe and North America from northern and western India to detour over the Arabian Sea towards Muscat. This detour adds between 45 minutes and two hours of extra flight time, driving up operational costs and fuel burn across several sectors. Naidu noted that the external affairs ministry (MEA) is engaging with China regarding the Hotan route. If discussions pan out, Indian airlines flying from Delhi and Mumbai would head towards Leh, enter Chinese airspace near Hotan, turn toward Kyrgyzstan, and connect to existing routes heading to Europe, the UK, and North America. Currently, all Indian carriers from the north and northwest follow the L639 route to avoid Pakistani airspace. The new route could lead to significant savings for destinations like Georgia, Baku, Central Asia, and northern Europe. The detour has been particularly costly for Air India, with former CEO Campbell Wilson estimating losses of ₹4,000 crore due to the airspace closure. However, Naidu did not indicate a timeline for the opening of the route or suggest that an agreement had been reached, noting that any new air corridor would require bilateral agreement, air traffic management coordination, and operational consensus.
news.background_context: Following the Pahalgam terror attack in April 2025, Pakistani airspace was closed to Indian carriers, requiring flights from northern and western India to detour over the Arabian Sea towards Muscat, resulting in extended flight times and higher operational expenses.

news.upsc_analysis: The pursuit of the Xinjiang air corridor highlights the intersection of geopolitics, aviation economics, and bilateral diplomacy. The closure of Pakistani airspace demonstrates how regional security incidents can impose heavy financial burdens on commercial aviation, prompting nations to seek alternative diplomatic and logistical pathways with neighboring countries like China.

hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत पाकिस्तानी हवाई क्षेत्र के निरंतर बंद होने के प्रभाव को कम करने के लिए चीन के शिनजियांग के ऊपर एक वैकल्पिक हवाई मार्ग तलाश रहा है। नागरिक उड्डयन मंत्री राम मोहन नायडू ने कहा कि होतान के ऊपर प्रस्तावित गलियारे को लेकर दोनों देशों के बीच चर्चा चल रही है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: भारत पाकिस्तानी हवाई क्षेत्र के निरंतर बंद होने के प्रभाव को कम करने के लिए चीन के शिनजियांग के ऊपर एक वैकल्पिक हवाई मार्ग तलाश रहा है। नागरिक उड्डयन मंत्री राम मोहन नायडू ने मंगलवार को यह जानकारी दी। अप्रैल 2025 में पहलगाम आतंकवादी हमले के बाद पाकिस्तानी हवाई क्षेत्र के बंद होने के बाद, उत्तरी और पश्चिमी भारत से यूरोप और उत्तर अमेरिका के लिए उड़ान भरने वाली भारतीय एयरलाइंस को अरब सागर के ऊपर से मस्कट की ओर चक्कर लगाने के लिए मजबूर होना पड़ा है। नायडू ने कहा कि दक्षिण-पश्चिम शिनजियांग में होतान के ऊपर प्रस्तावित गलियारा एक काफी छोटा मार्ग प्रदान करेगा। यदि चर्चा सफल होती है, तो दिल्ली और मुंबई से उड़ान भरने वाली भारतीय एयरलाइंस लेह की ओर बढ़ेंगी, होतान के पास चीनी हवाई क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करेंगी, किर्गिस्तान की ओर मुड़ेंगी और फिर यूरोप, यूके और उत्तर अमेरिका जाने वाले मौजूदा मार्गों से जुड़ेंगी।

news.headline: Older goods vehicles lose GRAP exemptions in Delhi-NCR as CAQM revises air curbs
news.story_lead: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has revised the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) schedule for Delhi-NCR, removing exemptions for BS-IV and below goods vehicles under the strictest stages. The updated framework formally incorporates previous ad-hoc restrictions into the core pollution-control plan. It also expands web-portal monitoring for dust-control measures to construction sites beyond municipal limits.
news.full_article_text: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has approved a revised Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) schedule that removes exemptions for older, polluting goods vehicles carrying essential commodities under Stages III and IV. Specifically, exemptions for light and medium goods vehicles (LGVs and MGVs) have been removed at Stage III, while trucks and heavy goods vehicles (HGVs) of BS-IV and below standards lose their exemptions at Stage IV. Although similar restrictions were previously enforced via separate administrative orders, they have now been formalised directly into the GRAP schedule. State governments are expected to enforce these measures and retain the autonomy to implement stricter localized directions. Under the updated schedule, commercial goods vehicles registered outside Delhi are restricted unless they meet BS-VI, CNG, LNG, or electric emission standards. Furthermore, the revised framework incorporates a total of 48 actions distributed across four stages: 25 under Stage I, eight under Stage II, 10 under Stage III, and five under Stage IV. Certain measures—such as regulations on diesel generator sets and the entry of BS-IV and below buses from neighbouring states—have been shifted from Stage II to Stage I to trigger earlier interventions. Restrictions on plying older four-wheelers have also been extended to Sonipat, adding to Gurugram, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, and Gautam Budh Nagar. Additionally, CAQM has extended web-portal registration and mandatory monitoring of dust-control measures to eligible construction and demolition sites located beyond municipal limits, covering urban, controlled, industrial, and highway corridor zones for plot areas of 500 square metres and above.
news.background_context: The Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) is a set of emergency measures implemented to prevent further deterioration of air quality in the Delhi-National Capital Region (NCR) once it reaches specific thresholds. The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) is a statutory body established to coordinate, monitor, and manage air quality in Delhi-NCR and adjoining areas.
bullet_points: CAQM revised the GRAP schedule, removing exemptions for BS-IV and below goods vehicles under Stages III and IV.
Light and medium goods vehicles (LGVs and MGVs) exemptions removed at Stage III; trucks and heavy goods vehicles (HGVs) exemptions removed at Stage IV.
The revised schedule features 48 total actions across four distinct stages.

Restrictions on plying older four-wheelers extended to Sonipat alongside existing NCR districts.
Web-portal registration and dust-control monitoring extended to construction sites beyond municipal limits for plots exceeding 500 square metres.
key_facts: The revised GRAP schedule contains 48 actions across four stages.
The threshold for construction and demolition site dust-control registration remains at 500 square metres of plot area.
Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Rajasthan exceeded their plantation targets, while Haryana's NCR districts achieved 6 million out of 12 million.
exam_relevance: Prelims: Environment pollution control bodies (CAQM), Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP), vehicle emission norms.
Mains (GS III): Conservation, environmental pollution and degradation, impact of policy measures on urban air quality.
news.upsc_analysis: The formalisation of vehicle curbs into the GRAP framework highlights regulatory shifts toward institutionalized air pollution governance in the Indo-Gangetic plain. Expanding monitoring beyond municipal limits addresses suburban sources of dust and emissions, emphasizing regional cooperative federalism in managing airsheds.
causes: Severe air pollution episodes in Delhi-NCR during specific seasonal windows.
High vehicular emissions from older commercial transport fleets (BS-IV and below).
Unmitigated dust emissions from construction and demolition activities outside municipal boundaries.
impacts: Stricter entry barriers for older commercial goods vehicles into Delhi.
Earlier activation of anti-pollution measures like diesel generator bans under Stage I.
Broader geographical enforcement of dust-control regulations across NCR construction zones.
challenges: Enforcing interstate vehicular restrictions across multiple NCR jurisdictions.

government_steps: Revision of the GRAP schedule by CAQM to include 48 comprehensive actions.
Extension of web-portal registration and monitoring for dust control to non-municipal areas.

constitutional_or_policy_link: Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021.
way_forward: Accelerating the transition of commercial freight fleets to electric, CNG, and LNG alternatives.
Enhancing public transport infrastructure to reduce reliance on older goods and passenger vehicles.

news.headline: Revanth Reddy's 'rich God, poor God' remark faces heat, BJP slams Telangana CM's 'statement
news.story_lead: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy sparked political outrage after claiming that Lord Ram is the God of the rich and Lord Shiva is the God of the poor. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) strongly condemned the statement, accusing him of trying to divide Hindus and create north-south divides, while the Congress party defended his remarks.
news.full_article_text: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy's recent remarks regarding Hindu deities Lord Ram and Lord Shiva have drawn severe criticism from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Speaking at a media event in Delhi, Reddy claimed that the Congress struggled to win in northern states because the BJP 'stole Lord Ram', whom he described as the God of the rich. Conversely, he claimed the party won in the south where Lord Shiva, whom he termed the God of the poor, is worshipped. BJP leaders, including Telangana BJP chief N Ramchander Rao and spokesperson Prakash Reddy, slammed the statements as absurd, objectionable, and damaging to the country's unity and integrity, calling for protests and effigy burnings. Meanwhile, Congress state president Mahesh Kumar Goud defended the Chief Minister, arguing that Lord Ram visually appears rich due to ornaments while Lord Shiva physically appears poor with no clothes, and accused the BJP of playing politics in the name of Lord Ram to woo voters.
news.background_context: The controversy emerged following statements made by Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy during a media event in Delhi, comparing the worship patterns of Hindu deities across northern and southern India and linking them socio-economically.

hindi_translation.headline: रेवंत रेड्डी के 'अमीर भगवान, गरीब भगवान' वाले बयान पर विवाद, बीजेपी ने सीएम के बयान की आलोचना की
hindi_translation.story_lead: तेलंगाना के मुख्यमंत्री रेवंत रेड्डी ने यह दावा करके राजनीतिक विवाद खड़ा कर दिया कि भगवान राम अमीरों के भगवान हैं और भगवान शिव गरीबों के भगवान हैं। भारतीय जनता पार्टी (बीजेपी) ने इस बयान की कड़ी निंदा करते हुए उन पर हिंदुओं और उत्तर-दक्षिण के बीच विभाजन पैदा करने की कोशिश करने का आरोप लगाया।

bullet_points: तेलंगाना के सीएम रेवंत रेड्डी ने दावा किया कि भगवान राम अमीरों के भगवान हैं और शिव गरीबों के भगवान हैं।

news.headline: HT Evening Brief: Diplomatic developments, political demands, and international updates
news.story_lead: External affairs minister S Jaishankar addressed India-US ties on Tuesday, highlighting challenges in trade and counter-terrorism cooperation. Meanwhile, political developments in India saw Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge call for the removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
news.full_article_text: Recent news developments cover a range of national and international events, including diplomatic discussions between India and the United States, domestic political demands regarding the election commission, and regional transport issues. External affairs minister S Jaishankar noted that bilateral ties between India and the US have faced challenges related to trade negotiations, tariff uncertainties, and differing concerns over terrorism originating from Pakistan. In domestic politics, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge demanded the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and outlined a five-point list of demands to enhance transparency in the electoral process. Internationally, Pakistan denied airspace permission to a Russian flight carrying a uranium shipment destined for Bangladesh's Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant. In the US, President Donald Trump dismissed a report claiming he was willing to offer sanctions relief to Iran, amid ongoing conflict that began on February 28, 2026. In sports, Neeru Dhanda secured a historic individual gold medal at the Asian Games in the trap final. Additionally, the film 'Drishyam: The Conclusion' recorded strong advance bookings ahead of its release.

hindi_translation.headline: एचटी ईवनिंग ब्रीफ: कूटनीतिक विकास, राजनीतिक मांगें और अंतरराष्ट्रीय अपडेट
hindi_translation.story_lead: विदेश मंत्री एस जयशंकर ने मंगलवार को भारत-अमेरिका संबंधों पर बात की और व्यापार तथा आतंकवाद के खिलाफ सहयोग में आ रही बाधाओं का जिक्र किया। इस बीच, घरेलू राजनीति में कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खर्गे ने मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार को हटाने की मांग की।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: हालिया समाचारों में भारत और अमेरिका के बीच द्विपक्षीय चर्चा, चुनाव आयोग में पारदर्शिता से जुड़ी घरेलू राजनीतिक मांगें, तथा क्षेत्रीय परिवहन के मुद्दे शामिल हैं। विदेश मंत्री एस जयशंकर ने कहा कि भारत और अमेरिका के बीच संबंधों में व्यापार वार्ताओं, टैरिफ अनिश्चितताओं और पाकिस्तान से पनपने वाले आतंकवाद को लेकर चिंताओं के कारण कुछ 'रुकावटें' आई हैं। घरेलू राजनीति में, कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खर्गे ने मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार को हटाने की मांग की और चुनावी प्रक्रिया में पारदर्शिता सुनिश्चित करने के लिए पांच सूत्रीय मांगें रखीं। अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर, पाकिस्तान ने बांग्लादेश के रूपपुर परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्र के लिए यूरेनियम ले जा रहे एक रूसी विमान को अपने हवाई क्षेत्र का उपयोग करने की अनुमति देने से इनकार कर दिया। अमेरिका में, राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प ने उन रिपोर्टों को खारिज कर दिया जिनमें दावा किया गया था कि वह ईरान को प्रतिबंधों से राहत देने के इच्छुक हैं। खेल के क्षेत्र में, नीरू धंडा ने एशियाई खेलों के ट्रैप फाइनल में शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए व्यक्तिगत स्वर्ण पदक जीता।

news.headline: Tattoo clue cracks Andhra murder case after woman’s body cut into 9 pieces, dumped in canal
news.story_lead: A distinctive tattoo on a woman's hand enabled police to identify her remains after her body was found cut into nine pieces in a canal in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. The investigation led to the arrest of a local butcher and an accomplice following disputes over money.
news.full_article_text: According to the police investigation, a woman's body was discovered in pieces in a canal in Ibrahimpatnam, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. Details of the unidentified body were circulated on social media, prompting relatives to recognize a tattoo on her hand and approach the police, which established her identity as Kalyani. The investigation led police to Shafi, a butcher who runs a small mutton shop in Bhavanipuram. Police found that Shafi and Kalyani had been closely associated and had disputes over money, alongside an earlier disagreement involving Kalyani's son that strained their relationship. On September 17, Shafi took Kalyani to his house in Bhavanipuram where a quarrel broke out over money. Shafi allegedly attacked her with a knife, slit her throat, and subsequently cut her body into nine pieces. With the assistance of an employee from his shop named Guruvulu, he allegedly transported the remains and dumped them in the Cooling Canal in the Gollapudi area. Both suspects have been detained for questioning. Additionally, a similar recent case in Bengaluru involved a man murdering his wife during a financial dispute and dumping her body in a vacant plot.
news.background_context: The case involves a murder investigation in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, where police utilized social media circulation and a victim's tattoo to identify the remains, subsequently tracing the suspects through local business connections.
bullet_points: A woman's body was found cut into nine pieces in a canal in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh.
A tattoo on the victim's hand circulated on social media helped relatives identify her as Kalyani.
Police investigation led to Shafi, a local butcher from Bhavanipuram, and his assistant Guruvulu.
The suspect allegedly attacked and killed the victim following a dispute over money on September 17.
The remains were transported and dumped in the Cooling Canal in the Gollapudi area.
A similar separate murder case involving a financial dispute occurred in Bengaluru.

news.headline: Pune fort murder: Ketan Agarwal got fiancée Siya Goyal’s name tattooed as birthday gift, says father
news.story_lead: New details have emerged in the Pune Lohagad Fort murder case regarding the victim Ketan Agarwal and his fiancée Siya Goyal. Ketan's father stated that his son had got his fiancée's name tattooed on his neck as a birthday gift before he was allegedly killed. Police have arrested Siya and her alleged lover in connection with the conspiracy.
news.full_article_text: As the investigation continues in the Pune Lohagad Fort murder case, fresh details have been shared by the victim's father, Vishal Agarwal. Ketan Agarwal allegedly died after being pushed off a cliff at Lohagad Fort near Pune on June 18. Ketan and his fiancée, Siya Goyal, had got engaged in February and were scheduled to marry later in the year. According to his father, Ketan had planned to celebrate Siya's birthday in Mahabaleshwar on June 19 and had inked her name on his neck as a birthday surprise. The Pune Rural Police chargesheet states that Siya and her alleged lover, Chetan Chaudhary, conspired to kill Ketan, using a fake Instagram account to lure him to the fort where he was allegedly pushed from a cliff. Both suspects were arrested in June.

news.headline: India rejects Turkish President Erdogan's UNGA remarks on Jammu and Kashmir
news.story_lead: India has strongly rejected remarks made by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan regarding the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir at the United Nations General Assembly. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that the matter pertains strictly to India's sovereignty and territorial integrity, adding that external parties have no locus standi on the issue.
news.full_article_text: India firmly rejected the references made by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan concerning the Indian Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir during his address at the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA). Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal asserted that the matter relates directly to India's territorial integrity and sovereignty, emphasizing that no external party possesses any locus standi on the issue. Turkish President Erdogan had stated in his UNGA address that disputes in South Asia, including Kashmir, should be addressed through dialogue within the framework of the United Nations Charter and relevant resolutions. India reiterated its consistent stance that bilateral issues between India and Pakistan do not require third-party mediation.
news.background_context: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan previously made remarks regarding the Kashmir issue during his UNGA address in September last year and during a visit to Islamabad, Pakistan, in February 2025, both of which were rejected by India as unwarranted and objectionable.
bullet_points: India rejected Turkish President Erdogan's remarks on Jammu and Kashmir at the UNGA.
MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated the matter pertains to India's sovereignty and territorial integrity.
India maintained that no external party has locus standi on the issue.
Turkey's President had suggested addressing the Kashmir issue through dialogue within the UN framework.
India maintains that bilateral issues with Pakistan do not require third-party mediation.

news.headline: NIA arrests 6 in Assam’s Barpeta, searches 16 sites in Imam Mahmuder Kafila terror probe
news.story_lead: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested six persons from Assam’s Barpeta district and conducted searches at 16 locations across Assam, West Bengal, and Kerala. The operation is part of an ongoing investigation into an alleged cross-border terror conspiracy and radicalisation network linked to Imam Mahmuder Kafila (IMK), an offshoot of the banned Jama’atul Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB).
news.full_article_text: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) arrested six persons from Assam’s Barpeta district and carried out searches at 16 locations across Assam, West Bengal, and Kerala. The searches were conducted in connection with an ongoing investigation into Imam Mahmuder Kafila (IMK), which investigators have identified as an offshoot of the banned terror group Jama’atul Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB). The six individuals arrested from Barpeta district have been identified as Mustafizur Rahman and Yakub Ali from Barpeta Road, Rakibul Islam from Howly, and Zakir Hussain, Chandbar Ali, and Faruk Abdullah from the Sarbhog area. NIA teams searched the residences of several suspects, seizing mobile phones and verifying identity documents such as Aadhaar and PAN cards. Family members of the detainees provided details regarding their backgrounds, including employment and previous legal encounters. For instance, Mustafizur Rahman was earlier arrested by the Assam Police Special Task Force (STF) on March 14 in connection with alleged jihadi activities and was subsequently released on bail. In June this year, the NIA filed a chargesheet before the NIA special court in Guwahati against 11 suspected operatives of JMB under various provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, and the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), 1967, following a multi-state operation initiated in December last year.
news.background_context: The investigation builds upon a multi-state operation led by the Assam Police STF in December last year, which resulted in the arrest of 11 suspected operatives in Assam, Tripura, and West Bengal. The case was subsequently taken over by the central agency, which alleged that the accused were part of a conspiracy to promote the extremist ideology of JMB's offshoot, Imam Mahmuder Kafila (IMK).
bullet_points: NIA arrested six persons from Assam's Barpeta district in connection with the Imam Mahmuder Kafila (IMK) terror probe.

Earlier in June, the NIA filed a chargesheet against 11 suspected operatives of the JMB offshoot under the BNS, 2023, and UAPA, 1967.
The case was originally pursued by the Assam Police STF before being taken over by the central agency.

It underscores the critical role of central investigative agencies and state police task forces in dismantling terror conspiracies through coordinated operations under stringent anti-terror laws like the UAPA.

hindi_translation.story_lead: राष्ट्रीय जांच एजेंसी (NIA) ने असम के बारपेटा जिले से छह लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया है और सीमा पार आतंकी साजिश तथा कट्टरपंथ नेटवर्क की जांच के सिलसिले में असम, पश्चिम बंगाल और केरल में 16 ठिकानों पर तलाशी ली है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: राष्ट्रीय जांच एजेंसी (NIA) ने मंगलवार को असम के बारपेटा जिले से छह लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया और प्रतिबंधित संगठन जमात-उल-मुजाहिद बांग्लादेश (JMB) के एक सहयोगी संगठन माने जाने वाले 'इमाम महमूदक काफिला' (IMK) की जांच के तहत राज्य में कई जगहों पर तलाशी ली। पुलिस के अनुसार, बारपेटा जिले से गिरफ्तार किए गए छह लोगों की पहचान मुस्ताफिजुर रहमान, याकूब अली, रकीबुल इस्लाम, जाकिर हुसैन, चांदबर अली और फारूक अब्दुल्ला के रूप में हुई है। एनआईए ने अभी तक गिरफ्तारियों पर कोई आधिकारिक बयान जारी नहीं किया है। इस वर्ष जून में, एनआईए ने पिछले साल दिसंबर में असम पुलिस एसटीएफ द्वारा गिरफ्तार किए गए JMB के 11 संदिग्ध गुर्गों के खिलाफ आरोप पत्र दायर किया था।
hindi_translation.background_context: यह जांच पिछले साल दिसंबर में असम पुलिस एसटीएफ के नेतृत्व में चलाए गए एक बहु-राज्यीय अभियान पर आधारित है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप असम, त्रिपुरा और पश्चिम बंगाल में संदिग्धों को गिरफ्तार किया गया था।
bullet_points: एनआईए ने असम के बारपेटा जिले में छह लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया।
असम, पश्चिम बंगाल और केरल में 16 ठिकानों पर तलाशी ली गई।
यह जांच इमाम महमूदक काफिला (IMK) से जुड़ी है, जो JMB का एक हिस्सा है।
key_facts: बारपेटा जिले से छह गिरफ्तारियां हुईं।
असम, पश्चिम बंगाल और केरल में छापेमारी की गई।

news.headline: MP govt to transfer ₹600 each to 5.8 million students for school uniforms
news.story_lead: The Madhya Pradesh government has decided to directly transfer ₹600 into the bank accounts of 5.8 million students to buy school uniforms. The decision comes after the state government failed to float the tender for school uniforms on time amid allegations of irregularities and a high court stay.
news.full_article_text: The Madhya Pradesh state cabinet approved ₹348.07 crore for the 2026-27 academic session to provide uniform allowances to 5.8 million students studying in Classes 1 to 8 in government schools. The funds will be disbursed via the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) process directly into the bank accounts of students and their parents five months into the academic session. Initially, the state government planned to provide stitched uniforms, but the tender process stalled due to objections, allegations that eligibility conditions excluded local industries, self-help groups (SHGs), and MSMEs, and a Madhya Pradesh high court stay on July 16 regarding a ₹350-crore tender. Additionally, the council of ministers decided to provide 20 percent horizontal reservation to 'Agniveers' in uniformed services such as police constables, special armed forces, jail guards, forest guards, and excise constables.
news.background_context: In 2018, then chief minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan had given SHGs the work to stitch nearly 11 million uniforms for over 5.5 million government school students under the State Rural Livelihood Mission. Since 2024, the state government has shifted toward directly transferring money to parents' bank accounts to buy uniforms.
bullet_points: Madhya Pradesh cabinet approved ₹348.07 crore for uniform allowances for the 2026-27 academic session.
₹600 will be transferred directly via DBT to 5.8 million students in Classes 1 to 8 in government schools.
The direct transfer decision was taken after delays and a Madhya Pradesh high court stay on a ₹350-crore tender.
Garment manufacturers had alleged that tender eligibility criteria excluded local industries, SHGs, and MSMEs.
The cabinet also approved a 20 percent horizontal reservation for 'Agniveers' in uniformed state services.

Number of beneficiary students: 5.8 million
Amount per student: ₹600
Target classes: Classes 1 to 8 in government schools
Agniveer horizontal reservation: 20 percent in uniformed services

news.upsc_analysis: The policy shift from centralized procurement to Direct Benefit Transfer highlights ongoing challenges in public procurement, transparency, and judicial oversight in administrative actions. It also reflects state-level policy adjustments concerning employment and social welfare schemes.

Madhya Pradesh High Court stay on the finalization of the ₹350-crore tender.
impacts: Direct financial transfer of ₹600 to 5.8 million students for purchasing school uniforms.

challenges: Delays in distributing uniform allowances five months into the academic session.

way_forward: Streamlining tender processes to ensure timely procurement and distribution of welfare materials.
Enhancing transparency and inclusivity for local MSMEs and self-help groups in government contracts.

While DBT ensures fund delivery to 5.8 million students, timely execution remains crucial for effective welfare delivery.

Evaluate the role of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mechanisms in bypassing procurement bottlenecks for social welfare schemes.

hindi_translation.story_lead: मध्य प्रदेश सरकार ने स्कूली यूनिफॉर्म खरीदने के लिए 58 लाख छात्रों के बैंक खातों में सीधे ₹600 ट्रांसफर करने का फैसला किया है। यह निर्णय समय पर टेंडर जारी करने में विफलता और अनियमितताओं के आरोपों के बीच लिया गया है।

news.headline: NIA arrests 13 in Assam, Bengal, and Kerala over links with IMK terror outfit
news.story_lead: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested 13 individuals across West Bengal, Assam, and Kerala for their alleged links with Imam Mahmuder Kafila (IMK), an offshoot of the banned terror outfit Jamaat-ul-Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB). Raids were conducted across 16 locations in the three states as part of an ongoing terror probe involving online radicalisation.
news.full_article_text: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) arrested 13 persons from West Bengal, Assam, and Kerala for their alleged links with Imam Mahmuder Kafila (IMK), an offshoot of the banned terror outfit Jamaat-ul-Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB). Four persons were arrested in West Bengal, eight were intercepted in Assam, and one was held in Kerala following raids across 16 locations. The Union government had previously banned the JMB and all its manifestations under section 35 of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 in May 2019. Investigations revealed that the accused were attempting to expand the IMK's ideology and network in West Bengal and north-eastern states through religious indoctrination, extremist literature, and digital platforms like a Telegram group called 'Purva Akash'. Digital devices including mobile phones, pen-drives, and memory cards were seized during the operations.
news.background_context: The Union government banned the Jamaat-ul-Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB) and all its manifestations under section 35 of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 in May 2019. Assam police had earlier arrested 11 persons in December 2025 regarding an online radicalisation module operated by Bangladesh-based handlers of IMK through a Telegram group named 'Purva Akash', after which the NIA took over the probe.
bullet_points: NIA arrested 13 individuals in West Bengal, Assam, and Kerala for links with Imam Mahmuder Kafila (IMK).
IMK is identified as an offshoot of the banned terror outfit Jamaat-ul-Mujahideen Bangladesh (JMB).
Raids were conducted across 16 locations in the three states.

Total locations raided: 16 locations across three states.

UAPA section invoked: Section 35 of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967.

exam_relevance: Prelims: National Investigation Agency (NIA), Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), internal security.

Mains (GS Paper III): Internal security, challenges to internal security through communication networks, role of external state and non-state actors, security challenges and their management in border areas.
news.upsc_analysis: The crackdown by the NIA highlights the persistent threat of cross-border terror outfits utilizing digital communication platforms for radicalisation and recruitment in India. The utilization of encrypted channels like Telegram for modules such as 'Purva Akash' underscores the evolving nature of cyber-terrorism and online radicalisation. Effective counter-terrorism requires robust inter-state intelligence sharing, stringent application of anti-terror legislations like the UAPA, and proactive monitoring of digital spaces.

Security concerns regarding cross-border infiltration and radicalisation modules.
challenges: Tracing operatives communicating through encrypted digital platforms.
Managing absconding suspects, including foreign nationals.
Preventing cross-border ideological spread and recruitment.
government_steps: Banning of JMB and its manifestations under section 35 of the UAPA in May 2019.
Coordinated raids across 16 locations by the NIA leading to multiple arrests.
Investigation into online modules and seizure of digital devices.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA), 1967
National Investigation Agency (NIA) Act, 2008
way_forward: Enhancing cyber-surveillance capabilities to detect and disrupt encrypted radicalisation modules.
Strengthening border intelligence and coordination between central agencies and state police forces.
Fast-tracking investigation and prosecution of terror-related cases under the UAPA.
news.mains_notes: The arrest of 13 individuals by the NIA across Assam, West Bengal, and Kerala highlights the threat posed by IMK, an offshoot of the banned JMB. The use of digital platforms like Telegram for modules such as 'Purva Akash' illustrates how modern terror networks leverage technology for recruitment. Countering this requires enhanced digital forensics, robust legal frameworks under the UAPA, and deep inter-state and international intelligence cooperation.

hindi_translation.headline: एनआईए ने आईएमके आतंकी संगठन से जुड़े संबंधों को लेकर असम, बंगाल और केरल में 13 लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया
hindi_translation.story_lead: राष्ट्रीय जांच एजेंसी (NIA) ने प्रतिबंधित आतंकवादी संगठन जमात-उल-मुजाहिद्दीन बांग्लादेश (JMB) के एक विंग इमाम महमुद्रे कफिला (IMK) से कथित संबंधों के लिए पश्चिम बंगाल, असम और केरल में 13 लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया है। ऑनलाइन कट्टरपंथ की जांच के तहत तीन राज्यों में 16 स्थानों पर छापे मारे गए।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: राष्ट्रीय जांच एजेंसी (NIA) ने प्रतिबंधित आतंकवादी संगठन जमात-उल-मुजाहिद्दीन बांग्लादेश के एक विंग इमाम महमुद्रे कफिला (IMK) से कथित संबंधों के कारण पश्चिम बंगाल, असम और केरल से 13 लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया। पश्चिम बंगाल में चार लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया गया, असम में आठ लोगों को पकड़ा गया और केरल में एक व्यक्ति को हिरासत में लिया गया। केंद्र सरकार ने मई 2019 में गैरकानूनी गतिविधियां (रोकथाम) अधिनियम, 1967 की धारा 35 के तहत JMB और उसके सभी रूपों को प्रतिबंधित किया था। जांच से पता चला कि आरोपी धार्मिक शिक्षा, चरमपंथी साहित्य और डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म के माध्यम से पश्चिम बंगाल और उत्तर-पूर्वी राज्यों में IMK की विचारधारा का विस्तार करने की कोशिश कर रहे थे।
hindi_translation.background_context: केंद्र सरकार ने मई 2019 में यूएपीए अधिनियम की धारा 35 के तहत जेएमबी को प्रतिबंधित किया था। असम पुलिस ने दिसंबर 2025 में 'पूर्वा आकाश' नामक टेलीग्राम ग्रुप के माध्यम से संचालित ऑनलाइन कट्टरपंथ मॉड्यूल में कथित संलिप्तता के लिए 11 लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया था, जिसके बाद एनआईए ने जांच अपने हाथ में ली।

news.headline: CISF Jawan Kills Four Colleagues in Suspected Fratricide in J&K's Kathua
news.story_lead: Four personnel of the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF), including an assistant commandant, were killed in a suspected case of fratricide in Jammu and Kashmir's Kathua district on Tuesday. The accused head constable used an AK-47 rifle during the incident following an altercation and was subsequently arrested.
news.full_article_text: Four personnel of the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) were killed in a suspected case of fratricide in Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday, according to Kathua Senior Superintendent of Police Mohita Sharma. The incident took place around 7:30 pm at the Sewa-III power project in Mashka village of Kathua district, where the personnel were guarding the hydroelectric power station located on the Sewa River, a tributary of the Ravi. The deaths were suspected to be the result of indiscriminate firing by an officer following an altercation between CISF personnel. The victims included assistant commandant Ankit Kumar Pandey, sub-inspector Lakshman Singh, and constables Rafiq Ahmed and Sandeep Kumar. All four succumbed to their injuries after being admitted to the NHPC Hospital in Himachal Pradesh. The accused, CISF head constable Abhidesh Singh, was overpowered by his colleagues and arrested after using an AK-47 to fire upon them. Police secured the area, and the CISF has planned to set up an internal inquiry to ascertain the circumstances leading to the incident.
news.background_context: The incident occurred at the Sewa-III hydroelectric power project located on the Sewa River in Mashka village of Kathua district, Jammu and Kashmir, where CISF personnel are deployed for security duties.

Addressing these challenges is vital for maintaining force morale, discipline, and internal security efficiency.

hindi_translation.headline: जम्मू-कश्मीर के कठुआ में सीआईएसएफ के जवान ने एके-47 से चार सहकर्मियों की गोली मारकर हत्या की, आरोपी गिरफ्तार
hindi_translation.story_lead: मंगलवार को जम्मू-कश्मीर के कठुआ जिले में केंद्रीय औद्योगिक सुरक्षा बल (CISF) के चार कर्मियों की संदिग्ध आंतरिक संघर्ष (फ्रैट्रिसाइड) में मौत हो गई। आरोपी हेड कांस्टेबल को गोलीबारी की घटना के बाद गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: कठुआ की वरिष्ठ पुलिस अधीक्षक मोहिता शर्मा के अनुसार, मंगलवार को जम्मू-कश्मीर में सीआईएसएफ के चार कर्मियों की संदिग्ध रूप से आपसी गोलीबारी में मौत हो गई। यह घटना कठुआ जिले के मशका गांव में Sewa-III पावर प्रोजेक्ट पर तैनात सीआईएसएफ कर्मियों के बीच हुए विवाद के बाद हुई। मृतक कर्मियों में सहायक कमांडेंट अंकित कुमार पांडे, एसआई लक्ष्मण सिंह और कांस्टेबल रफीक अहमद तथा संदीप कुमार शामिल हैं। सभी ने हिमाचल प्रदेश के एनएचपीसी अस्पताल में दम तोड़ दिया। आरोपी सीआईएसएफ कर्मी हेड कांस्टेबल अभिदेश सिंह को उसके अन्य साथियों ने दबोच लिया और गिरफ्तार कर लिया। उसने अपने साथियों पर गोली चलाने के लिए एके-47 का इस्तेमाल किया था।
hindi_translation.background_context: यह घटना जम्मू-कश्मीर के कठुआ जिले के मशका गांव में Sewa-III जलविद्युत परियोजना पर हुई, जहां सीआईएसएफ कर्मियों की तैनाती सुरक्षा के लिए की गई है।
bullet_points: कठुआ, जम्मू-कश्मीर में सीआईएसएफ के चार कर्मियों की मौत।
मृतकों में एक सहायक कमांडेंट, एक एसआई और दो कांस्टेबल शामिल।
घटना Sewa-III पावर प्रोजेक्ट पर एक विवाद के बाद हुई।
आरोपी हेड कांस्टेबल अभिदेश सिंह को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया है।
key_facts: चार सीआईएसएफ कर्मी कठुआ में मारे गए
हथियार: एके-47

news.headline: Kerala Man Arrested for Stabbing 20-Year-Old Woman at Resort in Pathanamthitta
news.story_lead: A 20-year-old female receptionist was stabbed to death at a private resort in Kerala's Pathanamthitta district on Tuesday. Police have arrested the accused, identified as Jithu, following the incident.
news.full_article_text: A 20-year-old woman named Dilsha, working as a receptionist at a private resort in Kozhencherry, Pathanamthitta district, Kerala, was allegedly stabbed to death by a man named Jithu on Tuesday. According to police and colleagues, the victim and the accused had been in a brief relationship which the victim had ended a month prior. Police suspect that revenge for the breakup served as the motive for the crime. The accused arrived at the resort around 1 pm on Tuesday, asked to speak to the victim, and an argument ensued in the resort courtyard. The accused then attacked her with a knife. Resort staff and locals apprehended the accused, tied him up, and handed him over to the local police. The victim was rushed to the nearest hospital, where she succumbed to her injuries.
news.background_context: The incident occurred at a private resort in Kozhencherry within Kerala's Pathanamthitta district, highlighting issues related to personal safety and violent crime.
bullet_points: A 20-year-old female resort receptionist, Dilsha, was killed in Pathanamthitta district, Kerala.
The accused, Jithu, was arrested at the scene by locals and resort staff who handed him over to the police.
Police and colleagues reported that the victim had ended a brief relationship with the accused a month prior.
The attack took place around 1 pm on Tuesday following a verbal argument in the resort's courtyard.
The victim succumbed to her injuries after being taken to the nearest hospital.
key_facts: Victim: Dilsha (20 years old)
Accused: Jithu
Location: Kozhencherry, Pathanamthitta district, Kerala
Date of incident: Tuesday
Time of incident: Around 1 pm
exam_relevance: General awareness and current news monitoring for regional incidents.
news.upsc_analysis: This is a localized law and order incident handled by the state police machinery. It highlights issues pertaining to public safety, gender-based violence, and the swift response of local citizens and law enforcement in detaining the suspect.
causes: Revenge suspected as the primary motive following the termination of a brief relationship.
impacts: Loss of a young life and immediate apprehension of the suspect by locals and police.
challenges: Ensuring workplace safety and addressing interpersonal violence and crimes of passion.
government_steps: Prompt police intervention, taking the accused into custody, and launching a thorough investigation.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Protection of life and personal liberty under Article 21 of the Indian Constitution.
way_forward: Strengthening institutional mechanisms for conflict resolution, mental health support, and public safety awareness.
news.mains_notes: A 20-year-old woman was murdered at a resort in Pathanamthitta, Kerala, by an individual allegedly motivated by a personal grudge following a breakup. The swift action of local staff and police ensured the apprehension of the suspect.
mains_questions: Discuss the social and legal implications of crimes driven by personal vendettas in contemporary society.
news.takeaway: A man was arrested for the fatal stabbing of a 20-year-old resort receptionist in Pathanamthitta district, Kerala.
prelims_facts: Pathanamthitta district is located in Kerala.
Kozhencherry is a locality in Pathanamthitta district.

hindi_translation.headline: केरल: रिसॉर्ट में 20 वर्षीय महिला की हत्या के आरोप में व्यक्ति गिरफ्तार
hindi_translation.story_lead: केरल के पतनमतिट्टा जिले में एक निजी रिसॉर्ट में मंगलवार को 20 वर्षीय महिला की चाकू मारकर हत्या कर दी गई। पुलिस ने आरोपी को गिरफ्तार कर लिया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: केरल के पतनमतिट्टा जिले के कोझेनचेरी स्थित एक निजी रिसॉर्ट में रिसेप्शनिस्ट के रूप में काम करने वाली 20 वर्षीय दिलशा की मंगलवार को जिथु नामक व्यक्ति ने कथित तौर पर चाकू मारकर हत्या कर दी। पुलिस और सहकर्मियों के अनुसार, दोनों के बीच एक संक्षिप्त संबंध था जिसे पीड़िता ने एक महीने पहले समाप्त कर दिया था। पुलिस को संदेह है कि रिश्ते के अंत का बदला इस हत्या का मुख्य कारण हो सकता है। आरोपी मंगलवार को दोपहर करीब 1 बजे रिसॉर्ट पहुंचा और पीड़िता से मिलने की मांग की। आंगन में दोनों के बीच कहासुनी हुई, जिसके बाद आरोपी ने उस पर चाकू से हमला कर दिया। रिसॉर्ट के कर्मचारियों और स्थानीय लोगों ने आरोपी को पकड़कर पुलिस के हवाले कर दिया। पीड़िता को नजदीकी अस्पताल ले जाया गया, जहाँ उसने दम तोड़ दिया।
hindi_translation.background_context: यह घटना केरल के पतनमतिट्टा जिले के कोझेनचेरी में एक निजी रिसॉर्ट में हुई।
bullet_points: केरल के पतनमतिट्टा जिले में 20 वर्षीय महिला रिसेप्शनिस्ट दिलशा की हत्या।
स्थानीय लोगों और रिसॉर्ट कर्मचारियों द्वारा आरोपी जिथु को पकड़कर पुलिस को सौंपा गया।
पीड़िता ने एक महीने पहले आरोपी के साथ अपने संबंध को समाप्त कर दिया था।
मंगलवार को दोपहर करीब 1 बजे बहस के बाद हुआ हमला।
key_facts: पीड़िता: दिलशा (20 वर्ष)
आरोपी: जिथु
स्थान: कोझेनचेरी, पतनमतिट्टा जिला, केरल

news.headline: Jamia Millia Islamia suspends PhD student over campus protest; AISA demands revocation
news.story_lead: Jamia Millia Islamia has suspended a PhD sociology student for five days following an unauthorised gathering at the central canteen on September 28. The student was accused of inciting students and disrupting academic activities, prompting the All India Students' Association (AISA) to demand an immediate revocation of the disciplinary action.
news.full_article_text: Jamia Millia Islamia has suspended a PhD student for five days for allegedly participating in an unauthorised gathering at the university's central canteen and inciting students to breach discipline. The administrative action followed a protest held on September 28 against the recent eviction of hostel residents, particularly women hostellers. According to the show-cause notice issued by the university's Chief Proctor, the PhD student in Sociology was suspended with immediate effect from September 28 until October 2 and barred from entering the campus during this period. The notice alleged that the student delivered a speech giving publicity to misleading accounts and rumours, which incited other students to breach discipline. The university stated that the gathering disrupted routine functioning in the north campus and affected teaching, learning, and research activities. In response, the All India Students' Association (AISA) condemned the suspension, asserting that the student was targeted for speaking in solidarity with women students regarding hostel accommodation, living conditions, and food quality. AISA also contended that the action violated the right to peaceful protest. Meanwhile, the university stated that students are permitted to congregate at a designated area near Gate No. 18, and noted that hostel rooms are allotted according to merit and university rules, with the affected students failing to meet eligibility criteria.
news.background_context: The disciplinary action emerged out of student protests at Jamia Millia Islamia regarding the eviction of certain women hostellers, hostel accommodation distribution, living conditions, and food quality, intersecting with university regulations on designated protest zones.
bullet_points: Jamia Millia Islamia suspended a PhD (Sociology) student for five days from September 28 to October 2.
The suspension followed an unauthorised protest gathering at the university's central canteen on September 28.
The protest was organised against the recent eviction of hostel residents, particularly women hostellers.
The university administration stated that the gathering disrupted academic and research activities in the north campus.
The All India Students' Association (AISA) condemned the suspension and demanded its immediate revocation.
The university maintained that a designated protest area near Gate No. 18 exists for students to express themselves within a democratic framework.
key_facts: University: Jamia Millia Islamia
Student suspended: PhD (Sociology) student
Suspension duration: Five days (September 28 to October 2)
Trigger event: Protest on September 28 against hostel evictions
Designated protest location: Area near Gate No. 18
exam_relevance: Prelims: General polity and institutional governance framework in higher education.
Mains: GS Paper II (Governance, Institutional framework, Student protests, and freedom of expression).
news.upsc_analysis: The incident highlights the ongoing friction in higher educational institutions between administrative discipline, maintenance of academic routines, and students' claims to freedom of expression and peaceful assembly. From a governance perspective, universities must balance institutional order and adherence to disciplinary codes with democratic principles of student representation and grievance redressal.
causes: Eviction of certain women hostellers based on merit and eligibility rules.
Student grievances regarding hostel living conditions and food quality.
Violation of university disciplinary ordinances through an unauthorised gathering at the central canteen.
impacts: Temporary suspension of a student and barring entry to the campus.
Escalation of student-administration friction with protests by student bodies like AISA.
Disruption of normal academic and research activities in the university's north campus.
challenges: Balancing the right to peaceful assembly and protest with the maintenance of institutional discipline and academic schedules.
Addressing student grievances transparently regarding hostel accommodations without compromising merit-based rules.
government_steps: Designation of a specific area near Gate No. 18 by the university administration for student assembly and expression.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Article 19(1)(a) and Article 19(1)(b) of the Constitution of India concerning freedom of speech and expression and peaceful assembly, balanced against reasonable restrictions under institutional discipline.
way_forward: Establishing institutional dialogue channels between the university administration and student representatives to resolve accommodation and hostel-related grievances amicably.
Ensuring strict adherence to due process and fair hearing in disciplinary matters involving students.
news.mains_notes: Student protests in central universities often highlight the tension between administrative disciplinary frameworks and democratic rights. Educational institutions require transparent grievance redressal mechanisms alongside defined codes of conduct to prevent disruptions to academic activities while protecting student welfare.
mains_questions: Discuss the balance between institutional discipline in higher educational institutions and the right of students to protest.
Examine the role of university administrations in addressing student grievances concerning hostel facilities and campus rules.
news.takeaway: Jamia Millia Islamia suspended a PhD student over an unauthorised canteen protest against hostel evictions, drawing strong opposition from student groups.
prelims_facts: Jamia Millia Islamia is a central university located in New Delhi.
The university administration designated an area near Gate No. 18 for student protests.

hindi_translation.headline: जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया ने विरोध प्रदर्शन के बाद पीएचडी छात्र को पांच दिन के लिए निलंबित किया, AISA ने वापसी की मांग की
hindi_translation.story_lead: जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया ने 28 सितंबर को केंद्रीय कैंटीन में एक अनधिकृत सभा में शामिल होने के आरोप में एक पीएचडी छात्र को पांच दिन के लिए निलंबित कर दिया है। इस कार्रवाई के बाद ऑल इंडिया स्टूडेंट्स एसोसिएशन (AISA) ने तुरंत निलंबन वापस लेने की मांग की है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया ने विश्वविद्यालय की केंद्रीय कैंटीन में अनधिकृत सभा में कथित रूप से शामिल होने और छात्रों को अनुशासन भंग करने के लिए 'भड़काने' के आरोप में एक पीएचडी छात्र को पांच दिन के लिए निलंबित कर दिया है। यह कार्रवाई 28 सितंबर को हॉस्टल के निवासियों, विशेषकर महिला हॉस्टल के निवासियों को हटाए जाने के विरोध में हुए प्रदर्शन के बाद की गई। विश्वविद्यालय के मुख्य प्रॉक्टर द्वारा जारी कारण बताओ नोटिस के अनुसार, समाजशास्त्र के पीएचडी छात्र को 28 सितंबर से 2 अक्टूबर तक तत्काल प्रभाव से निलंबित किया गया है और इस अवधि के दौरान उसे परिसर में प्रवेश करने से प्रतिबंधित कर दिया गया है।
hindi_translation.background_context: यह अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया में महिला हॉस्टल निवासियों के निष्कासन और हॉस्टल सुविधाओं से जुड़े छात्र विरोध प्रदर्शनों के बाद सामने आई है।
bullet_points: जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया ने एक पीएचडी छात्र को 5 दिन के लिए निलंबित किया।
यह कार्रवाई 28 सितंबर को केंद्रीय कैंटीन में हुए अनधिकृत प्रदर्शन के बाद की गई।
AISA ने इस निलंबन की निंदा करते हुए इसे तुरंत वापस लेने की मांग की है।
key_facts: विश्वविद्यालय: जामिया मिलिया इस्लामिया
निलंबित छात्र: पीएचडी (समाजशास्त्र)
अवधि: 28 सितंबर से 2 अक्टूबर
